rows: Every validated StackTarget relation in stack order: one baseline per item, then every declared target including player targets. Existing V4 tensors are unchanged.
node_binding: V4 raw-to-tensor projection, never card-token matching. Baseline and player-target rows have no target node.

layout.5: relation secondary order / 16, zero for baseline
layout.8..11: kind one-hot: spell, activated, triggered, madness offer
layout.16..24: cast method one-hot: absent, normal, alternative, flashback, madness, plotted, escape, bestow, omen
layout.25..280: mode_chosen one-hot for all 256 u8 values; zero is primary mode, also used by non-modal items
layout.305..308: target kind one-hot: none, object, actor player, opponent player
layout.309..311: announcement-time object-target controller: actor, opponent, none

message: tanh(W * [features, source object-base hidden, target object-base hidden or zeros]), no bias, W initialized to exact zero. Add each message once to its source and once to a distinct object target before legacy node update. No new legacy graph nodes or edges.
scope: Finalized public stack only. Does not implement Escape, expose pending private cast choices, change rewards, enable costs/prevention, or establish strength. No truncation of stack or targets.
